# API Documentation

## Overview

This API implements the PDF/A standard.[^pdfa]

## Methods

### createDocument()

Creates a new PDF document.[^pdflib]

The document follows ISO 19005-1 specifications.[^iso]

## Notes

[^pdfa]: PDF/A is an ISO-standardized version of PDF specialized for digital preservation.

[^pdflib]: Implementation uses pdf-lib library: https://pdf-lib.js.org/

[^iso]: ISO 19005-1:2005 - Document management - Electronic document file format for long-term preservation.
